dialogueSequence.en: Aigoo~ You ate everything! Even the side dishes I refilled 3 times!
Six friends, 45,000 won. How shall we pay?

question.en: What do you ask before paying?

choices.en: Split it, or is someone treating?

choices.ko: 무조건 한 명이 다 내야 해!

wrongFeedback.ko: 한턱내기도, 나눠 내기도 해. 먼저 물어봐!
wrongFeedback.en: Treating and splitting both happen. Ask first!

correctFeedback.ko: 좋아! 계산 방법은 함께 정하면 돼.

description.ko:
뭐야?! 호랑이의 목이... 부드러워지고 있다?!
이제 하루에 20번이고 고개를 숙일 수 있다!
description.en:
What?! The tiger's neck... is getting flexible?!
Can now bow 20 times a day with ease!

gameplayEffect.ko: NPC 근처를 지나갈 때 자동으로 꾸벅 인사!

question.en: In a hurry, how do you board?

wrongFeedback.en: Safety before speed! No need to rush.

correctFeedback.en: Well done! Let people exit first.

description.ko:
뭐야?! 호랑이의 털이... 빠지고 있다?!
피부가 점점 매끈해진다...
description.en:
What?! The tiger's fur... is falling out?!
The skin is getting smoother...

dialogueSequence.en: *An ajumma in FULL hiking gear stands next to you.*
*LOUD sigh* 요즘 젊은 것들... (These days, young people...)

question.ko: 할머니가 너를 쳐다보고 계신다. 어떻게 할래?
question.en: She's eyeing you. What do you do?

choices.en: Avoid eye contact, pretend to sleep
Put on headphones, turn up the K-pop
Excuse me, halmeoni. Can I help you with your bag?

wrongFeedback.ko: 할머니가 널 시험하고 있었어! 한국에서 어르신을 먼저 도와드리는 건 정말 존경받는 행동이야. 공짜 귤 기회를 놓쳤다!
wrongFeedback.en: She was testing you! In Korea, proactively helping elders is deeply respected. You missed a free tangerine!

correctFeedback.ko: 할머니가 주머니에서 귤을 꺼내 주신다. 이건 최고의 영예야. 한국 할머니에게 입양당했다!
correctFeedback.en: She hands you a tangerine from her pocket. This is the highest honor. You've been adopted by a Korean grandma!

description.ko:
뭐야?! 호랑이의 혀가... 변하고 있다?!
"Three" → "Seuree"
"Think" → "Sink"
이제 TH 발음이 안 된다!
description.en:
What?! The tiger's tongue... is changing?!
"Three" → "Seuree"
"Think" → "Sink"
Can no longer pronounce "TH"!

dialogueSequence.ko: *치맥 중. 치킨 한 마리가 거의 끝났다.*
dialogueSequence.en: *Chimaek in progress. The chicken is almost gone.*
*One last piece sits on the plate.*

question.ko: 마지막 한 조각, 먼저 어떻게 할까?
question.en: One piece left. What do you do first?

choices.en: Eat it! Can't let it go to waste.
"아 I'm so full~" and don't eat it.
Would anyone like the last piece?

wrongFeedback.ko: 무조건 남길 필요는 없어. 먼저 물어보자!
wrongFeedback.en: No rule says to leave it. Ask the others!

correctFeedback.en: Nice! You checked with your friends.

description.ko:
뭐야?! 호랑이의 몸 비율이... 변하고 있다?!
팔다리가 짧아지고, 허리가 길어진다!
description.en:
What?! The tiger's body proportions... are changing?!
Limbs getting shorter, torso getting longer!

dialogueSequence.en: *Chatting with a friend at a cafe*

dialogueSequence.ko: 야, 너 내일 학원 안 가?
dialogueSequence.en: Hey, aren't you NOT going to academy tomorrow?

question.en: You're not going. How should you answer?

choices.en: Yes, I'm not going. (한국식 / Korean way)
No, I'm not going. (영어식 / English way)

wrongFeedback.ko: 한국어에서는 상대방 말이 맞으면 "응"이야! "안 가?" → 맞아, 안 가 → "응, 안 가." 영어식으로 "No"라고 하면 한국인은 "아 그럼 간다는 거야?" 하고 헷갈려!
wrongFeedback.en: In Korean, "응" confirms the other person is correct! "Aren't you going?" → Right, I'm not → "응, 안 가." If you say "No" in English style, Koreans get confused: "Oh so you ARE going?"

correctFeedback.ko: 축하해! 한국어 응답 체계를 완벽하게 이해했어! 이제 네 뇌는 한국어로 작동한다!
correctFeedback.en: Congrats! You've mastered the Korean response system! Your brain now operates in Korean!

description.ko:
뭐야?! 호랑이의 머리카락이... 까매지고 있다!
변환 완료! 호랑이가 한국인이 되었습니다!
description.en:
What?! The tiger's hair... is turning jet black!
Transformation complete! The tiger has become Korean!
